name: dayquest-mobile
description: DayQuest ADHD Task Initiation & Flow Mobile App

scripts.serve: npm run build && npx serve public
scripts.cap:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync
scripts.cap:android: npm run build && npx cap sync android && npm run verify:web -- android/app/src/main/assets/public && npm run cap:icons && npx cap open android
scripts.cap:ios: npm run build && npx cap sync ios && npx cap open ios
scripts.build: npm run build:styles && npm run build:app && npm run build:mobile
